analysis: The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md. The patch (unit 7e16eb3337db8652:1) adds one bullet under 'Unreleased — provider 0.9.17' at about line 37. It says the provider will honor an explicitly configured TMPDIR for anonymous runtime metallib snapshots, preserve unlink-before-copy and digest binding, and fail on an invalid or unwritable explicit directory with no fallback. This is documentation only, so no executable code, wire format, authorization, or attestation behavior changes in this PR. The source diff for the provider code that the entry describes was not supplied, so I could not review it. A next pass that does see that code should check that a user-controlled TMPDIR cannot be used to swap the metallib snapshot between digest verification and load. It should also check that the TMPDIR directory is not world-writable or symlink-exploitable, and that the snapshot is not left readable by other local processes. Relevant threat IDs are T-013 and T-034 for binary or code tampering, and T-050 for temp-file plaintext exposure. The entry claims digest binding and unlink-before-copy, which are the mitigations that matter here. The changelog itself does not weaken any assumption in the threat model. No finding is warranted, and the missing source is a coverage limit.
